title: Coordination nomenclature
basic_overview: Name ligands, then metal, then oxidation state; anionic complexes use -ate conventions.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Ligands first; OS last in Roman numerals.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. List ligands alphabetically. 2. Apply multiplicative prefixes. 3. Calculate OS. 4. Name metal. 5. Add counter ion.
extra_info_content.factors: Ambidentate and bridging ligand names require special notation.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
